title: PJM Reliability Backstop Procurement results — the first PJM capacity print able to clear above the $325 collar cap
source: NEWS: utilitydive.com/news/pjm-backstop-capacity-auction-ferc-data-centers/826792/ fetched direct 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200) — 'PJM aims to announce the backstop auction results by Dec. 2' before holding the base capacity auction for the 2029/30 delivery year, on a central bid window of 2026-09-30 to 2026-10-21 with a $555/MW-day cap and a $20B budget (FERC docket ER26-3380-000, filed 2026-07-31). Corroborated by a search-relayed reading of electroneconomics.substack.com/p/pjms-reliability-backstop-procurement ('results due by December 2, before the next base auction opens') and, on sequencing only, by foleyhoag.com's July note ('Results are anticipated to be released by December') and utilitydive.com/news/pjm-board-backstop-capacity-auction-data-center-curtailment/826347/ ('15-year commitments would be finalized before PJM holds its base capacity auction for the 2029/30 auction'). Filed estimate: PJM's posted RPM page (pjm.com/markets-and-operations/rpm, fetched direct 2026-09-08, HTTP 200) publishes no RBP schedule, no FERC order accepting ER26-3380 was found as of 2026-09-08, the date is an 'aims to' target downstream of a bid window that has not opened, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep
notes: DISCOVERED during the pjm-capacity-auction-2026-12 pulse-check adjacency sweep (2026-09-08). Why it earns a row: this is the print that carries the information the December BRA cannot. pjm-capacity-auction-2026-12's own research (2026-08-17) concluded that the FERC-accepted $325/$175 collar has turned the 2029/30 BRA into a known number and that price discovery does not return until the 2030/31 BRA, ~May 2027 (est.). The RBP's $555/MW-day cap breaks that: if it clears below $555, that is the first observed market price for new PJM supply in the collar era; if it pins at $555, the shortfall is priced above the collar and the scarcity read is confirmed at a higher level than the RPM auction can express. Either way it lands roughly two weeks BEFORE the 2029/30 BRA and re-prices the shortfall the BRA then faces, so the December BRA becomes the sequence's SECOND print, not its first. Impact medium and symbols empty on the proposing ledger's own grounds (no tracked name is an IPP; the exposed names live in docs/research/ai-energy-constraint.md). Estimate — nothing here licenses a date-keyed entry, and the whole chain is conditional on FERC accepting ER26-3380 by 2026-09-29.
